ActiveRun.description: One run of a DAG that is running or queued now.

raw.description: The engine's own status for the run when it differs from `status`, shown as is.

startedAt.description: When the run started, or was queued while it waits, ISO 8601 UTC (`2026-10-02T17:00:00Z`).

step.description: The step the run entered last among those running; empty while it is queued or between steps.

stepStartedAt.description: When the run entered `step`, ISO 8601 UTC; empty when `step` is.

steps.description: Each of the DAG's steps by name with its status in this run.

ActiveRun.title: ActiveRun

ArchiveRequest.description: `POST /api/archive`: archive `task`, or each of `tasks` in one call, recording `reason` when it is not blank.
ArchiveRequest.title: ArchiveRequest

ArchivedEach.description: A batch archive's answer: the tasks it archived, and each refused task with why.
ArchivedEach.title: ArchivedEach

BuildEvent.description:
The page build the server serves, sent right after each connect's snapshot: a hash of the built page's `index.html`,
which names every chunk it loads by its digest. A page that holds another build than the one it is named is out of date.
BuildEvent.title: BuildEvent

Calibration.description: The forecast scored on the latest fifth of the ended runs against a chain fitted on the others.
Calibration.title: Calibration

Capabilities.description: What the board writes beyond moves: the page draws Edit, Archive… and New task only for what its board does.
Capabilities.title: Capabilities

CaseRef.description: One session's work on one task (`task` None: a branch that names none).
CaseRef.title: CaseRef

Cell.description: Median steps per clean completion of one kind and size, over its latest-fifth holdout.

completions.description: Completions in the cell, clean or not.

holdout.description: The latest fifth of the clean completions by end time, rounded up.

median_operator_prompts.description: Human prompts after the task's claim.

median_steps.description: Of the holdout's steps, a subagent's included.

median_steps_before_edit.description: None when no holdout task made an edit.

Cell.title: Cell

Cells.description: `GET /api/analytics/cells`: cells with at least 5 clean completions; a smaller cell reports nothing.
Cells.title: Cells

Cite.description: The sentence of a skill that sends a session down a transition.
Cite.title: Cite

ClaimRelease.description: The claim a Board task's claim-TTL sweep released: when, and the session, last renewal and TTL it released.

at.description: When the release was recorded, epoch seconds.

last_renewal.description: The session's last renewal before the release, epoch seconds.

ttl.description: The claim TTL, in seconds, the session missed.

ClaimRelease.title: ClaimRelease

ClaimRequest.description:
`POST /api/claim`: move `task` to In Progress and record `session` as its assignee, an opaque string; the same
assignee claiming again changes nothing, and an assignee already on another open claim is refused.
ClaimRequest.title: ClaimRequest

ClusterMedoid.description: The case nearest every other by normalized LCS distance between traces, and the cluster's usual spread.
ClusterMedoid.title: ClusterMedoid

ClusterOutlier.description: A case far from the medoid: `deletions` are the medoid's activities it lacks, `insertions` its own extra.
ClusterOutlier.title: ClusterOutlier

CompleteRequest.description: `POST /api/complete`: move the Done task `task` into the board's completed tasks.
CompleteRequest.title: CompleteRequest

ContractCheck.description: One check of the contract between the config and the machines' DAG cues.
ContractCheck.title: ContractCheck

ContractReport.description: The contract checks `starpulse doctor` runs; `ok` is false when any fails.
ContractReport.title: ContractReport

CostToGo.description: `GET /api/analytics/cost-to-go`: every state of each skill machine, whatever its `n`; a consumer holds a cell with a small one.
CostToGo.title: CostToGo

Cpu.description: The share of the host's CPU an instance's scheduler and workers used since the last reading.

cores.description: How many cores the host has.

share.description: Their CPU time over all the host's cores, from 0 to 1.

Cpu.title: Cpu

CreateRequest.description:
`POST /api/tasks`: create a task in the lane `status` names or else the board's starting lane, stamped
`created_by: <harness>:<session>`, or each of `tasks` in one call, each with its own title and details.
CreateRequest.title: CreateRequest

CreateSpec.description:
One task a create files: its `title` and details, and an optional `ref` that a sibling in the same batch names
as `ref:<label>` in its `dependencies`.

Text is trimmed; list items are trimmed and blank ones dropped, or refused where the list must hold only text.
`task`, `size` and `skill` are read and left unused by a create.
CreateSpec.title: CreateSpec

CreatedEach.description: A batch create's answer: each spec's new task, or why it was refused, in the order the specs came.
CreatedEach.title: CreatedEach

Cue.description: A DAG that runs on the same trigger as a Board event's writer but writes no lane itself.

grace.description: Seconds after the event a run of the DAG may take to start before the Ledger draws the merge overdue.

resolves.description: How a failed run of the DAG clears: `forced` only on a green forced rerun, `next` on the DAG's next green run.

Cue.title: Cue

DagBody.description: A runs workflow as the page draws it: the latest run, the runs in flight and the pool it runs on.

active.description: Every running or queued run of the workflow, including concurrent ones.

pool.description: The name of the pool the workflow runs on; empty when none.

raw.description: The engine's own status when it differs from `status`.

rerun.description: What the workflow declares about a rerun repeating its effects; None when it declares nothing.

schedule.description: The cron expressions that start the workflow; empty when it runs only when asked for.

stats.description: The workflow's runs over the last seven days; None when it never ran or they are unknown.

DagBody.title: DagBody

Decile.description:
One decile of forecast chance of the goal on the held-out runs: its forecasts' mean against the share of
their runs that reached the goal, null when it holds none.
Decile.title: Decile

DocCreateRequest.description: `POST /api/docs`: file a doc; only the title is required. `type` is `specification`, `guide`, `readme` or `other`.
DocCreateRequest.title: DocCreateRequest

DocRecord.description: A doc as the board's reader gives it: the summary and the text after its front matter.
DocRecord.title: DocRecord

DocRestoreRequest.description:
`POST /api/docs/restore`: return the archived doc `doc` to `folder` under the board's docs (the docs folder
itself when absent), unchanged.
DocRestoreRequest.title: DocRestoreRequest

DocSummary.description: A doc as the board's lister gives it: its front matter and where it is filed, without its body.
DocSummary.title: DocSummary

Docs.description: `GET /api/docs`: every open doc, by ascending number.
Docs.title: Docs

Domain.description: A domain's DAGs, and whether each is declared safe to run from the page; `processes` package them when configured.
Domain.title: Domain

DomainProcess.description: A named package of a domain's DAGs.
DomainProcess.title: DomainProcess

DonePage.description: `GET /api/done`: the next page of done tasks past their hot day, newest first, and whether older ones remain.
DonePage.title: DonePage

EditRequest.description: `POST /api/edit`: change fields of `task`; `base` holds the value each changed field had when the page read it.
EditRequest.title: EditRequest

FlowEdge.description: One directly-follows edge of a transition's graph.

cut.description: `source` is a judgement cut: the agent chose there.

skill.description: The skill in force: the transition.

target.description: The activity that directly follows it, or `[end]`.

FlowEdge.title: FlowEdge

FlowGraph.description: `GET /api/analytics/graph`: the branching directly-follows graph of each transition, Codex left out.
FlowGraph.title: FlowGraph

Forecast.description:
One run still going: where it is, its loops so far, and from its state's row the chance of each terminal and
of the goal and its expected days to finish, with `n`, the times that row was seen leave. Null with no row.
Forecast.title: Forecast

GapWarning.description: The history lost entries between two ids, so any number here may miss some.
GapWarning.title: GapWarning

Harnesses.description: `GET /api/harnesses`: the tiers in order and each harness with its models and efforts.
Harnesses.title: Harnesses

Health.description: `GET /api/analytics/health`: the Board's flow health over a window.
Health.title: Health

kind.description: Whether the next edge runs a skill or an operation.

name.description: The skill or operation the edge hands to.

current.description: The state the task holds in the skill machine.

name.description: The skill machine the task is in.

next.description: The edge the skill declares; null when none is declared.

states.description: The skill machine's state ids, in declared order.

LaneHistory.description: `GET /api/history?task=`: a task's lane changes, oldest first.
LaneHistory.title: LaneHistory

Launch.description: A runs workflow's launch: the skill it starts and the machine that skill draws, null when it has none.
Launch.title: Launch

LedgerChange.description: A later event of `GET /api/ledger/<event>/events`: the rows that are new or differ; every other row stands.
LedgerChange.title: LedgerChange

LedgerFail.description: A failed run of a cue the merge row holds open: the step it stopped at, and how the failure clears.
LedgerFail.title: LedgerFail

LedgerPage.description:
`GET /api/ledger/<event>`, and the first event of `GET /api/ledger/<event>/events`: a Ledger's rows, newest first,
and whether older ones remain.
LedgerPage.title: LedgerPage

LedgerRow.description:
One merge occurrence: its pull request and commit, the runs paired with it by DAG, and, for another repository's
merge, the parent merge that pinned it.

appliedBy.description: The parent merge's key whose pin bump applied this one; null until one has; absent on a merge of the main repository.

LedgerRow.title: LedgerRow

LedgerRun.description: One DAG run a merge row carries: `inferred` when time, not the commit, paired it, and `ambiguous` how many other merges landed in its window.
LedgerRun.title: LedgerRun

LedgersDelta.description:
The merge strip and pins since the last event, whole. A Ledger's rows are not here: a page that has one open
reads `GET /api/ledger/<event>/events`.
LedgersDelta.title: LedgersDelta

LevelLoop.description: One back-edge across the runs that took it, summed from the runs' own figures.
LevelLoop.title: LevelLoop

dagActors.description: Only the board machine: the writers that are runs workflows.

launches.description: Only the board machine: the skill machine each launching DAG starts.

mainLine.description: Only the board machine: the state ids along its axis, in order (New to Done).

next.description: The edge a finished skill hands to; null when the machine declares none.

source.description: The third party whose events move this machine ("GitHub"); absent for a machine StarPulse's own actors move.

submachines.description: The machines that open under this machine's states; the board's first is its In Progress delivery machine.

tiers.description: Only the board machine: the state ids the Star Map draws at each stage, left to right, a tier's states stacked in its cell; a state no tier names is drawn with the tier at the mean of the tiers its transitions join it to, stacked in it or in a tier of its own after it, else in a tier of its own after the last, and with none the Board draws its own columns.

MachineHistory.description: `GET /api/history?task=&machine=`: a task's path on one machine, and how many steps it has taken.
MachineHistory.title: MachineHistory

MachinePage.description: The first page of machines entered from `open`, by name; their bodies are in the snapshot's `flows`.
MachinePage.title: MachinePage

MachineRow.description: A machine of `GET /api/machines`: whole, with its derivation.
MachineRow.title: MachineRow

role.description: The type the machine declares the state: `initial`, `final`, `resting`, `waiting_on_fact` or `waiting_on_person`; null when it declares none.

MachineStrip.description: The last 24 hours of machine entries, counted over every machine.
MachineStrip.title: MachineStrip

Machines.description: `GET /api/machines`: the next page of machines entered from `open`.
Machines.title: Machines

MergeStrip.description: The 24-hour strip of the merge ledger: per bucket, the merges, the failed ones and the forced reruns.
MergeStrip.title: MergeStrip

MilestoneCreateRequest.description: `POST /api/milestones`: open a milestone; only the title is required.
MilestoneCreateRequest.title: MilestoneCreateRequest

MilestoneRecord.description: A milestone as the board's reader gives it: its sections as text and bullet lists, and its whole description.
MilestoneRecord.title: MilestoneRecord

Milestones.description: `GET /api/milestones`: every open milestone, by ascending number.
Milestones.title: Milestones

MissRequest.description: `POST /api/miss`: file the task `fix` and record `check` of `task` as missed, naming it, in one write.
MissRequest.title: MissRequest

MissedLoads.description: `GET /api/analytics/missed-loads`: per declared skill, the cases that ran its trigger without loading it.
MissedLoads.title: MissedLoads

MissedSkill.description: A declared skill: the cases that performed what should load it, and those that did not load it.

listed.description: The `list` most recent missed cases, newest first.

MissedSkill.title: MissedSkill

Move.description: The verdict on moving a task to one column: allowed, or guarded by a declared rule.

actors.description: The verdict for an actor a guard treats apart from the rest, such as one it exempts, by actor; any other actor meets the move's own.

allowed.description: False when a guard the board writer enforces would refuse the move.

reason.description: What the refusing guard needs; empty when the move is allowed.

skill.description: The skill that produces what the guard needs; empty when allowed.

writers.description: The actors the machine YAML declares for the event behind the move; empty when it declares none, and then any actor may make it.

Move.title: Move

MoveDelta.description: A task a machine event placed on another machine.
MoveDelta.title: MoveDelta

MoveRequest.description: `POST /api/move`: move `task`, or each of `tasks` in one call, to the column `to`.
MoveRequest.title: MoveRequest

Moved.description:
A move's answer. The operator's move of an unheld task into the working state also starts its session: `url`
opens it, or `startError` says why none started.
Moved.title: Moved

MovedEach.description: A batch move's answer: the tasks it moved, and each refused task with why.
MovedEach.title: MovedEach

ParkRequest.description:
`POST /api/park`: pause `task` on exactly one reason, which picks the lane: `untilTask` (tasks that must reach
Done, or `TASK-N#K` for one open criterion of a task) and `until` (criteria a check can observe) wait; `operator` (what only the operator can do) needs attention.
ParkRequest.title: ParkRequest

Pool.description: One concurrency pool: the cap on the runs that may execute at once, and the runs holding or awaiting it.

cap.description: The most runs the pool lets execute at once.

name.description: The pool's name, unique on its scheduler; a DAG's `pool` names it.

queued.description: The runs waiting for the pool to have room.

running.description: The runs executing on the pool now.

Pool.title: Pool

Pull.description: One pull request a task cites, as GitHub last answered the server.

behind_main.description: Commits `main` holds that the PR's head lacks; null once the head branch is gone.

conflicting.description: The open PR conflicts with its base branch.

merge_sha.description: The merge commit's SHA; null until the PR merges.

merged_at.description: When the PR merged, ISO 8601 UTC; null until it does.

repo.description: The `org/repo` the PR belongs to; a number alone repeats across repositories.

stale.description: Always false: nothing polls GitHub, so a record is current until a newer event lands.

Pull.title: Pull

PullRecord.description:
One pull request the PR store read from GitHub, as of `fetchedAt` (epoch seconds).

`headRefName` and `unresolvedThreads` (the first 100 threads) are null for a record saved before they were kept.
PullRecord.title: PullRecord

PullThread.description: An unresolved review thread: its id and the login of its first comment's author, null for a deleted account.
PullThread.title: PullThread

Pulls.description: `GET /api/pulls`: the stored pull requests matching every filter given, by repository then number.
Pulls.title: Pulls

QuietHours.description:
A daily window in which the scheduler admits nothing: `start` up to `end`, `HH:MM` in `timezone`; an `end` before
`start` runs past midnight.

timezone.description: The IANA zone the window's times are read in, such as America/Phoenix.

QuietHours.title: QuietHours

Rating.description:
A task's latest pass/fail rating: its verdict, the reason it names (empty when none), when it was set (epoch
seconds), who set it (`actor`, empty when the write named none) and how many changes the task's rating has had.
Rating.title: Rating

RatingRequest.description:
`POST /api/rating`: record one change of `task`'s pass/fail rating: `pass`, `fail` with an optional `reason`, or
`cleared`. Every change is kept; the latest one is the task's rating.
RatingRequest.title: RatingRequest

RawTask.description: A Backlog task. On the board its state is its lane; on every other machine, the state its latest machine event left it in.

adr_needed.description: Why a Board task needs an ADR; empty or absent when it needs none.

assignee.description: The session that last claimed a Board task; empty when none has, absent off the Board.

claim_expires_at.description: When a held Board task's claim expires, its last renewal plus the claim TTL, epoch seconds; null when unheld, not In Progress, or before the first sweep pass.

created.description: When a Board task was created, in epoch seconds; null or absent when unknown.

criteria.description: A Board task's acceptance criteria in file order; absent off the Board.

definition_of_done.description: A Board task's Definition of Done items in file order; absent off the Board.

dependencies.description: A task's dependencies, as task ids.

duplicate_resolution.description: How a Board task's duplicate search resolved its candidates; empty or absent when none.

duplicate_search.description: The queries a Board task's duplicate search ran; empty or absent when none.

entered.description: When a Board task entered its lane, epoch seconds; absent when the server holds no time for it.

impact.description: A Board task's Impact (low, medium or high); empty or absent when it has none.

interactive.description: Whether an accepted take-over made the task interactive; absent off the held view.

milestone.description: A Board task's milestone; empty or absent when it has none.

move_set.description: A snapshot's key into its `move_sets` for the task's `moves`; absent when it has none.

moves.description: The verdict on each Board column the task may move to, by state id; a snapshot names the set in `move_set` instead, and a delta carries it here.

pause_reason.description: Why a paused Board task waits for a person; empty when it is not paused, absent off the Board.

previous.description: The Board lane the task left on its last move; absent before it has moved.

profile.description: The agent profile a Board task is routed to; empty when none, absent off the Board.

prs.description: A task's pull requests: the PR URLs among its references.

readable.description: The first `readable` guard rule a Board task's description breaks, with its line; empty when it reads well, absent off the Board.

released.description: The claim-TTL release a Board task's claim ended in; null when none ended it.

runs.description: A task's scheduler runs: those whose run id names it (`dag-run-task-<N>-<ts>`).

skill.description: The skill machine an In Progress task is held in; absent off the held view.

task.description: A machine's task: the id of the Backlog task its events name.

type.description: A Board task's type; empty or absent when it has none.

urgency.description: A Board task's Urgency (low, medium or high); empty or absent when it has none.

workable.description: Whether a Board task can be worked now.

workable_since.description: Since when a workable Board task has been, epoch seconds.

RawTask.title: RawTask

Rerun.description: What a DAG declares about a rerun of it: safe (all None), once per `key`, or repeating its effects.

key.description: What the DAG keys its effects by, so a rerun for the same key repeats none; None when it declares no key.

repeats.description: Why a rerun repeats the DAG's effects; None when the DAG declares it does not.

step.description: The step whose effects repeat; None when the DAG names none.

Rerun.title: Rerun

RestartingEvent.description: The server was told to stop and will not answer after this: sent to every open stream before it exits.
RestartingEvent.title: RestartingEvent

RestoreRequest.description: `POST /api/restore`: return the archived task `task` to the board's tasks, unchanged; the writer names who did.
RestoreRequest.title: RestoreRequest

RetireRequest.description: `POST /api/retire`: take the finished task `task` off the board into the history store's retired tasks.
RetireRequest.title: RetireRequest

RetiredImportRequest.description: `POST /api/retired/import`: keep the retired task file `name`, holding `text`, in the history store.
RetiredImportRequest.title: RetiredImportRequest

RetiredTask.description: A retired task as the board's history store keeps it: its id, its file name and the file's text, byte-for-byte.
RetiredTask.title: RetiredTask

RetiredTasks.description: `GET /api/retired[?task=<id>]`: every retired task, or the one `task` names, by id.
RetiredTasks.title: RetiredTasks

ReviewRequest.description:
`POST /api/review`: move `task` to Review, adding `references` and `summary` first so the configured rules judge
the record the move would leave.
ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest

Roles.description:
Which of the board's States play which part, as its machine declares them: a client reads these and never a
State's name.

attention.description: Where a task waits on a person.

done.description: Where the work is done: a resting State, else the final one.

final.description: Where a task is settled for good.

ready.description: Where a task waits to be picked up.

review.description: Where a task waits on its pull request.

startable.description: The States a session starts a task from.

waiting.description: Where a task waits on its Start Criteria or dependencies.

working.description: Where a session works a task.

Roles.title: Roles

RunDiff.description: One transition's reference run against its slowest clean run.

conformant.description: Of `runs`, those that conform to the skill's machine.

reference.description: The fewest-step conformant clean run; None when `conformant` is 0.

reference_only.description: Activities the reference made more often than the slow run.

slow_only.description: Activities the slow run made more often than the reference.

RunDiff.title: RunDiff

RunDiffs.description: `GET /api/analytics/diff`: a transition with under 5 clean runs reports nothing; one with none that conforms has `conformant` 0.
RunDiffs.title: RunDiffs

RunLoop.description: One back-edge a run took: its trips and the days they took, from the target's previous visit to each return.
RunLoop.title: RunLoop

RunStats.description: A DAG's runs over the last seven days.

failureShare.description: The share of those runs that failed; None while none is over.

hours.description: The summed duration of the window's runs that are over, in hours.

medianSeconds.description: The median duration of those runs; None while none is over.

p95Seconds.description: The 95th-percentile duration of those runs; None while none is over.

runs.description: The runs that began in the window, over or not.

RunStats.title: RunStats

SchedulerDimension.description: One capacity dimension's use against its limit: percent for `cpu` and `memory`, a count for `sessions`, points for `review`.
SchedulerDimension.title: SchedulerDimension

SchedulerHarnessSessions.description: One harness's scheduler sessions in flight against its own session cap.
SchedulerHarnessSessions.title: SchedulerHarnessSessions

SchedulerNext.description: The task the loop would admit next, or, when none fits, the top-ranked one and what it waits on.

priority.description: The Priority matrix cell the task ranked by, `<impact>/<urgency>`, or `default` when it has no Impact or Urgency.

reason.description: `goes next`, `quiet hours` while the quiet hours hold admission, `<harness> usage limit` while that harness is paused, or the first dimension the task overfits, which the strip shows after `waits:`.

SchedulerNext.title: SchedulerNext

SchedulerOperatorTask.description: A task in the eligible lane that waits on the operator's decision rather than on capacity.
SchedulerOperatorTask.title: SchedulerOperatorTask

SchedulerPause.description: A harness whose admission is paused until `until` after a usage or credit limit.

until.description: When admission for this harness may resume, in epoch seconds.

SchedulerPause.title: SchedulerPause

SchedulerRequest.description: `PUT /api/scheduler`: whether the scheduler admits tasks, which harness it starts on, and/or its quiet hours.
SchedulerRequest.title: SchedulerRequest

SchedulerSession.description: A session the scheduler started whose task is still running: the strip's Sessions menu draws one row of it.

model.description: The task's agent profile, empty when it has none.

started.description: When the loop started the session, in epoch seconds.

url.description: The session's address, as `start` answered it.

SchedulerSession.title: SchedulerSession

SchedulerStatus.description:
Whether the scheduler admits tasks, and the capacity strip's readings; no dimensions before the first sample.

`inFlight`, `next`, `sessionsByHarness` and `needsOperator` are served only by a server that runs a dispatch loop; without one they
are absent.

harness.description: The harness the loop starts sessions on; defaults to claude.

inFlight.description: Every live session holding an In Progress task, oldest first; `url` is empty for one the loop did not start.

needsOperator.description: The `kind-decide` tasks in the eligible lane, which the scheduler never starts: the operator decides.

next.description: Null when no task in the eligible lane is workable.

pauses.description: Harnesses whose admission is paused until `until`. Absent when none are paused.

quietHours.description: Null when no window holds admission back.

sessionsByHarness.description: Each harness's in-flight count against its session cap; the Sessions meter follows `harness`.

SchedulerStatus.title: SchedulerStatus

SearchHit.description: One task a search found: where it is now, and the text around the match.
SearchHit.title: SearchHit

SearchResults.description:
`GET /api/search?q=&limit=&label=&finished_within_days=`: the tasks holding every word of `q`, best match first,
each carrying every `label` and, with `finished_within_days`, open or finished within that many days.
SearchResults.title: SearchResults

SessionHealth.description: One harness session's work on one task (`task` None: a branch that names none), from its OTLP signals.
SessionHealth.title: SessionHealth

SessionStep.description: One model request of a harness session, with the skill in force when it ran and the calls it made.

activities.description: What each call it made performed, in order, with no arguments.

at.description: When the request was logged, in epoch seconds.

captured.description: False for a harness the steps-per-completion ledger does not cover (Codex).

eval.description: The purpose an eval run stamped with the configured `eval_attribute`; empty for any other request.

keys.description: One per call: the shell command the instance's redactor left, else the tool's name.

skill.description: The skill most recently loaded in the session, counting this step's own; `none` before any.

SessionStep.title: SessionStep

SessionSteps.description: `GET /api/analytics/steps`: every model request of a window, oldest first.
SessionSteps.title: SessionSteps

Sessions.description: `GET /api/analytics/sessions`: session and slice health over a window.
Sessions.title: Sessions

Settled.description: A task that left the Board's lanes for good: where it settled, when, and the title, assignee, milestone and labels it settled with.

milestone.description: The milestone it settled in; empty when it had none.

Settled.title: Settled

SkillRefusal.description: A refusal a skill satisfies: the skill that produces what the guard needs.
SkillRefusal.title: SkillRefusal

SliceHealth.description: What the sessions that worked one task did together.
SliceHealth.title: SliceHealth

boardUrl.description: The Backlog board a task links into.

capabilities.description: What the board writes: the task modal draws Edit and Archive only when its board does.

claims.description: Each task's latest In Progress claim the board writer refused an agent, and when (epoch seconds).

cold_done.description: The ids of the done tasks from before local midnight that the board feed holds as a stub, left out of `flows`: the full view (`?view=full`) only, the page reads them from `/api/done` and `/api/task/<id>`.

cpu.description: The CPU share of each runs instance's scheduler and workers, by instance name.

cues.description: The DAGs cued by a Board event.

graphs.description: Every lifecycle machine the server draws, and `runs`.

hint.description: A Backlog.md project found beside the config while the default board is shown, and how to switch to it.

interactive.description: Each task an accepted take-over made interactive, by task id; a task never taken over is absent.

mergePins.description: The pinned merge rows of the last day that the newest page leaves out.

milestone_done.description: How many tasks each milestone has completed, counted over every settled task though `settled` holds only the recent ones.

move_sets.description: Each distinct set of Board-column verdicts a task's `move_set` names, by key.

pools.description: The concurrency pools the DAGs run on.

pulls.description: Each open task's pull requests, by task id.

ratings.description: Each rated task's latest pass/fail rating, by task id; a task never rated is absent.

reading.description: True while a just-started server is still reading its board: its Board is partial until a snapshot without it follows.

roles.description: Which State plays which part on the board.

StaleEdit.description: An edit refused because a field changed since the page read it: those fields with their current values.
StaleEdit.title: StaleEdit

StartRequest.description:
`POST /api/start`: start a session for `task` on `profile`; `harness` defaults to `claude`.

`assignee` is the legacy name of `profile` and is read when `profile` is absent.
StartRequest.title: StartRequest

StateCost.description: One skill-machine state's expected cost-to-go within a kind and size.

cost_to_go.description: The expected agent steps from a run's first step in the state until the run ends.

n.description: The times the state was seen left in the clean completed runs.

state.description: A stage of the skill's machine, or `[start]` before its first.

StateCost.title: StateCost

Step.description: One step of a DAG in its latest run.

depends.description: Names of the steps that must finish before this one starts.

kind.description: The phase kind the step declares (`agent`), or None when it declares none.

last.description: The step's outcomes in the runs that are over, newest first, at most five; empty when the scheduler keeps none or the step never ran.

lock.description: The lock the step takes so no other holder runs at once; None when it declares none or the scheduler has no lock to declare.

name.description: The step's name, unique within its DAG.

precondition.description: What must hold for the step to run, as the scheduler states it; None when it declares none.

raw.description: The engine's own status for the step when it differs from `status`, shown as is.

status.description: The step's status in the latest run.

Step.title: Step

Stuck.description: The longest-stuck task of a machine and every machine nested below it: idle over two hours outside a final state.

since.description: When the task last moved, epoch seconds.

Stuck.title: Stuck

SubStage.description: One stage mined at the judgement cuts of the stretches no skill governs, this week and the week before.

previous_runs.description: Runs it occurred in over the window before.

runs.description: Runs the stage occurred in over the window; 0 when it did not occur.

stability.description: Of the cell: stages in both windows over stages in either; None when a window mined none.

stage.description: The cut that opens the stage, `[start]` for the first.

SubStage.title: SubStage

SubStages.description: `GET /api/analytics/stages`: sub-stages and their stability from one window to the one before.
SubStages.title: SubStages

Submachine.description: Where a Board state opens into another machine, and which Board event each inner final state fires.

parent.description: The machine the link opens under: `board`, or the machine whose `state` it hangs off.

routes.description: Inner event to the Board event it fires; empty when the link routes none.

when.description: What has to hold for the inner machine to run under `state`; empty when always.

Submachine.title: Submachine

TakeOverRequest.description: `POST /api/take-over`: flip the unattended task `task` to interactive; its workflow types nothing more.
TakeOverRequest.title: TakeOverRequest

TaskCriterion.description: One acceptance criterion of a Board task and whether it is checked.
TaskCriterion.title: TaskCriterion

TaskDelta.description: A Board task that moved (`agent` null once it left the lanes).
TaskDelta.title: TaskDelta

TaskEventHistory.description: `GET /api/history?task=&hours=`: every machine event of a task in the window, oldest first.
TaskEventHistory.title: TaskEventHistory

TaskRecord.description: `GET /api/task/<id>`: the full record of a task from the board's reader, keyed by its editable fields.
TaskRecord.title: TaskRecord

TaskRun.description: One scheduler run a task's id names, linked to the run's own page.
TaskRun.title: TaskRun

Tie.description:
Where a lifecycle machine is entered from.

`declared` is a Submachine on `machine`'s `state`; `observed` is the state the task held on `machine` when its session
entered this one; `dag` is a launch by `dag`, which names no machine or state. `count` is the sessions entered
through it, null for a launch.

when.description: What has to hold for a declared tie to run; empty otherwise.

Tie.title: Tie

TraceCluster.description: Cases that did the same distinctive work, and the skills that covered it.

descriptors.description: The features with the most weight across the cases: `a:` activity, `r:` area read, `w:` area written.

key.description: A stable id: the digest of the sorted descriptors.

skills.description: The three most loaded skills, less the lifecycle skills.

uncovered.description: Cases that loaded no skill beyond the lifecycle skills.

TraceCluster.title: TraceCluster

TraceClusters.description: `GET /api/analytics/trace-clusters`: recurring work, ranked by distinct sessions.

cases.description: Cases with a trace in the window.

clustered.description: Cases that joined a cluster, whatever its size.

TraceClusters.title: TraceClusters

Trajectories.description: The trajectory analytics: the paths of the runs that ended in a terminal over a window.
Trajectories.title: Trajectories

cite.description: The skill sentence that authorizes the transition; absent when its YAML cites none.

TransitionCost.description: The cost of one skill in force, within one kind and size of task.

agent_s.description: The seconds of the steps' requests and tool calls.

kind.description: The `kind-*` label of the tasks, without the prefix.

peak_context.description: The most input, cache-read and cache-write tokens one request held.

skill.description: The skill in force on the steps; `none` before any load.

wasted_steps.description: Steps with a call that failed, was refused by a guard or hook, or repeats the command before it.

TransitionCost.title: TransitionCost

Transitions.description: `GET /api/analytics/transitions`: what each skill cost within each kind and size, Codex left out.
Transitions.title: Transitions

UnknownLaneWarning.description: A lane that is no Board state.
UnknownLaneWarning.title: UnknownLaneWarning

Verdict.description: What a guard says to one actor about a move: allowed, or the reason and skill of the rule that refuses it.

allowed.description: False when a guard would refuse the move to this actor.

reason.description: What the refusing guard needs; empty when allowed.

skill.description: The skill that produces what the guard needs; empty when allowed.

Verdict.title: Verdict

VerdictDelta.description: One qa lens's verdict on a task, as the ingest took it.
VerdictDelta.title: VerdictDelta

VerdictRequest.description:
`POST /api/verdict`: record `verdict` (`pass` or `miss`) for `check` of `task`'s `## Post-merge Checks`.

A `miss` names the task `fix` that repairs it; `evidence` is kept in the verdict's comment.
VerdictRequest.title: VerdictRequest

WindowState.description: `/api/history-window`: the effective window, the declared default, and whether Admin's override is in effect.
WindowState.title: WindowState

WindowTooLong.description: A level or telemetry window longer than its history, with the history's length.
WindowTooLong.title: WindowTooLong

Writer.description: Who fires a Board event: a runs workflow (by `<instance>/<workflow>` name), `operator` or `agent`.
Writer.title: Writer

description: The root of `api.schema.json`: every body as a property, so the generated types name each one.
title: ApiContract
